decisions: Use a provider-neutral Generative Media Capability Mesh; do not create a HiDream application or HiDream authority.
Keep the capability baseline at 175 and create no new architectural authority.
Reuse existing FA3 image, multimodal context, motion/video and refinement contracts rather than duplicate them.
Use only published canonical donor patterns in this materialization.
HiDream organization donor is discovery/provenance parent only; child repositories remain non-admitted until explicitly marked and independently reviewed.
Model Router remains provider/model authority; HRB remains device/resource authority; Temporal remains durable workflow authority.
MM skill routing is advisory/scoring only.
Static GUI materialization requires physical Current Host requalification before runtime/global promotion; no simulated PASS is permitted.
